had a great experience at my recent appointment with Dr. Marshall. He was incredibly kind, attentive, and took the time to truly listen to my concerns. It felt like a return to the days when GPs had the time to have meaningful discussions about your health rather than rushing through appointments.

Dr. Marshall also saw my son on a separate occasion and was absolutely amazing. He noticed that my son’s breathing was too fast and made sure he was seen by hospital staff before sending us home.
